title: Chunk Record
description: The chunk record the ingest pipeline emits per unit of retrievable text. Hash-keyed so unchanged documents are not re-chunked, and embedded per chunk so mixed embedders per license tier are supported.

chunk_id.description: Stable id = doc_id + '#' + ordinal + content_hash prefix; unchanged content keeps the same id

section_ref.description: Human addressable ref: control id, clause ref, obligation id, chapter, page/paragraph

char_span.description: Character span in the source document, so a citation can point at the exact location

embedding_hash.description: Hash of the embedding vector; detects embedder/model changes that invalidate the index
